metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully stretched the Columbus skyline image (Picture 2, 11.64x8.61cm) on slide 1 to fill the full page, keeping proportions and centering it.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select images, resize with keep-ratio via Position and Size dialog, navigate slides, and delete shapes.
metadata.explanation: Hardened version chains the original image-stretch goal with deleting the small 6.98x6.98cm emblem shape (Picture 3) from slide 1. Evaluator awards 0.5 for correct stretch+center and 0.5 for Picture 3 being absent. Initial state scores 0.0 (Picture 3 exists, image not stretched). [Fixed: renamed function MD5 suffixes from 8-char '0c8d85ea' to correct 32-char 'bd30ea01dba8f440569b065c94e4f32f' (hash of '5d901039-a89c-4bfb-967b-bf66f4df075e|1')]

scoring_breakdown.image_stretch_and_center: 0.5 - Picture 2 on slide 1 width ~25.4cm, centered within 0.8cm tolerance
scoring_breakdown.picture3_deleted: 0.5 - No shape named 'Picture 3' exists on slide 1

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the saved PPTX file from disk (file-based state, no postconfig needed) and extracts image dimensions/position for Picture 2 and existence of Picture 3 on slide 1.

Metric covers both instruction sub-goals: (1) stretch+center check via fills_width/fills_height with 0.8cm tolerance and explicit centering math, (2) Picture 3 deletion check via picture3_exists boolean.
fills_width OR fills_height logic is semantically correct for proportional scaling — the image fills one dimension fully while the other is slightly smaller.
Centering logic correctly handles both width-constrained and height-constrained cases, computing expected offset for the non-full dimension.
Partial credit 0.5+0.5 aligns with the two composed sub-goals in the instruction.
Negative control resistance is solid: initial state has Picture 3 present and image not stretched, scoring 0.0.
picture3_exists uses exact name match (shape.name == 'Picture 3') which is appropriately strict for detecting deletion.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: 'Picture 2' in shape.name could theoretically match 'Picture 20' or similar, but best_width disambiguation mitigates this in practice — acceptable as-is.
